jobs.title: Engineering Program Manager (EPM)
jobs.description:
The Apple Services Engineering team is one of the most exciting examples of Apple’s long-held passion for combining art and technology. These are the people who power the App Store, Apple TV, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts, and Apple Books. And they do it on a massive scale, meeting Apple’s high expectations with high performance to deliver a huge variety of entertainment in over 35 languages to more than 150 countries. Our Program Managers partner with engineers who build secure, end-to-end solutions. Thanks to Apple’s unique integration of hardware, software, and services, engineers and Program Managers partner to get behind a single unified vision. That vision always includes a deep commitment to strengthening Apple’s privacy policy, one of Apple’s core values. Although services are a bigger part of Apple’s business than ever before, these teams remain small, nimble, and cross-functional, offering greater exposure to the array of opportunities here.
Apple Cloud Infrastructure team, as part of the Apple Services Engineering team, is seeking an extraordinary Engineering Program Manager (EPM) that can help our internal device cloud, supporting all of Apple’s hardware, software, and services. Your work will help Apple ship entirely new products and features, as well as providing critical infrastructure to ensure existing ones continue to meet a high standard.

We're a fast-paced organization with ambitious goals, a large user base, and the autonomy to build the future of Apple devices. You will have exposure to the latest and greatest software features from their initial concepts on Apple’s iOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS, and macOS platforms and work on integrating our software with features in these operating systems. You will be responsible for driving and delivering programs collaborating with teams nearly across all engineering organisations at Apple in this role with broad cross-functional exposure.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
8+ years experience in software development project management in compute Infrastructure domains.
Proficiency and experience end to end project delivery; building roadmaps through to operational sustainability.
Proficiency and experience in delivering large scale infrastructure programs, deployments to AWS/Azure/GCP compute platforms.
Exceptional organizational, project management, and technical acumen with expertise in execution, prioritization, risk assessment.
Ability to drive engineering discussions for prioritizing features, technical road maps.
Strong facilitation skills (requirements sessions, design meetings, progress and status meetings).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to represent at all levels of the organization.
Experience with technical skills: Networking Protocols, Strong OS Fundamentals, Distributed Systems, Infra at scale, SDLC
BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related degree or related professional experience
Preferred qualifications:
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Agile project experience with evidence and able to demonstrate knowledge.
SCRUM background and/or played the role of a Scrum Master is plus.
Self-motivated and proactive with demonstrated creative and critical thinking capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple simultaneous end to end infrastructure, technical projects and stakeholder community comprising of various engineering teams and their partners

jobs.title: Privacy Program Manager, Privacy Management Office
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here at Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

At Apple, we deliver products, technologies, and services to inspire creativity and enrich lives. Apple has become one of the most recognized and trusted brands in the world. As such, we hold ourselves to the highest standards to maintain public and employee trust by ensuring compliance with data protection and international privacy laws.
The ideal candidate will successfully lead Privacy Compliance programs, projects, and initiatives, managing competing priorities and aligning diverse business interests to deliver impactful outcomes. They will take a deeply hands-on approach with cross-functional partners, building strong relationships and developing a thorough understanding of their goals, objectives, and existing commitments. The role requires driving decisions, resolving critical issues, and facilitating conflict resolution through communications that are neutral, approachable, and grounded in data.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
5+ years experience managing complex technical and non-technical projects and cross-functional initiatives.
Support design and implementation of privacy initiatives to deliver best-in-class privacy practices.
Develop and deliver privacy training and awareness programs for employees.
Proven experience analyzing, interpreting, summarizing, and presenting data.
Ability to accommodate various time zones to support international stakeholders.
BS/BA degree required.
PMP certification or equivalent experience.
This role will work extensively with our teams in China so proficiency in Mandarin is required.

2+ years of experience in data privacy initiatives or relevant technology products.
Ability to lead, take action, and provide goal-oriented direction in the face of ambiguity and guide cross-functional teams, manage stakeholder expectations, and foster collaboration.
Work with legal and teams to track privacy and data protection compliance throughout project lifecycles using excellent organizational skills with attention to detail.
Self-starter, comfortable in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
Curious, flexible, and a dedicated problem solver, with a focus on listening and learning.
Comfortable influencing project decisions, identifying risks, and proposing mitigation plans.
Ability to manage multiple projects within tight timeframes and deliver on time-bound initiatives.
Familiarity with Appleʼs core products and operating systems, and tools like Keynote, Pages, Numbers, and project management software (Wrike/Omniplan).
Law degree, MBA, or other advanced degree.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Product Localization Management (PLM)
jobs.description:
Product Localization Management (PLM) is an integral part of the Product Launch Readiness (PLR) team within Americas (AMR) Operations. We are looking for a Program Manager with a record of successful influence, cross-functional collaboration, and tactical execution to join our Product Localization team. You should have strong teaming skills and experience, with a working knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Systems as well as solid background in Product Configuration, supply chain, and project management. Key areas of expertise for this role are Product Localization Strategy, Bills of Materials (BOMs) Configuration, and Regulatory Compliance Change Management. You will contribute to the successful execution of all localized requirements for Latin America while influencing and executing in an environment of ambiguity. In close collaboration with the Global PLM Team, you will be making strategic recommendations to support NPI go-to-market planning, execute company’s Compliance and Environmental strategy across the full portfolio of products, and enable ongoing efficiency and quality improvements across PLM processes and tools.
The AMR PLM Program Manager should be a driven, flexible, and articulate problem solver who can multi-task under dynamic timelines to meet product launch objectives, delivering timely solutions for custom Localization requirements across a broad range of NPI and sustaining products. You will work independently in managing a portfolio of localized product configuration Bills of Material (BOMs) for AMR and influence cross-functional resources to meet deadlines. In addition to the tactical execution of these BOMs, you will manage ongoing compliance projects to ensure adherence to all requirements for shipping product into Latin America. Collaboration with multiple groups incl: Regulatory and Environmental Compliance, NPI Launch Readiness, Trade Compliance, Product Marketing, Product Configuration, Hardware Legal, Region Legal, Engineering, Localization & Release Engineering and others will be critical to build and deliver solutions to meet the needs of our evolving business.
Responsibilities
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
BA/BS Required. In a relevant field such as Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science or Management Information Systems, or relevant field.
6+ years of experience in program or project management
Solid working knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, BOM Configuration, and Product Localization
Consistent record of leading global, strategic projects, combined with a strong ability to execute tactical activities and tasks under tight and competing deadlines
Experience in program and/or project management with very strong analytical problem-solving skills
Proven experience working optimally in a matrixed and global organization
Demonstrated ability in business process re-engineering with an acute attention to detail and continuous innovation
Preferred qualifications:
MBA or Advanced Degree preferred.
Drive AMR Product Localization and SKU Optimization strategy, in close collaboration with Global cross-functional teams
Develop and support PLM processes that ensure that all Apple products have markings, inbox content, and labeling that conform with country-specific regulations and allow us to successfully import into North and South America
Manage BOMs (Bill of Materials) related to NPI Localization, sustaining updates, and customization requests.
Enable Regulatory Change Management throughout the whole lifecycle of Apple products.
Support Product Launch Readiness team on go-to-market strategy planning and launch execution.
Drive large scale, multi-year, multi-$M capital project roadmap to improve long-term capabilities & scale business processes.
Identify process improvement opportunities (tools, workstreams, systems) and drive solutions from conception through implementation. Support continuous innovation within the team, advocating directs to use subject matter expertise to drive positive change management.
Stitch across a global cross-functional teams throughout the supply chain, both technical and functional, adjusting communication and messaging for intended audience/stakeholders.
Explain complex localization, product configuration, and compliance concepts, processes, and plans to cross-functional partners to ensure transparency and alignment during launch planning
Engage with cross-functional stakeholders to gain perspective on scalability, risk, and unique regional differences; drive best practices globally and strengthen harmony among integrations.
Own new product/systems/tool launch plans, providing updates on critical checkpoints and elevating risks to business partners and executive team.
Partner with cross-organizational teams to roll out new products, systems, and solutions to market while ensuring complete confidentiality; driving organizational, systems, and people readiness.
Present, defend, and influence supply chain PLM capability and technology roadmap to Apple’s senior executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Develop and utilize analytical models to evaluate complex data sets, identify trends, and provide actionable insights to drive critical business decisions.
Influence and triangulate cross-functional alignment within a matrixed organization
Evaluate supply chain product launch readiness risks and implement contingency plans to mitigate consumer impact, including ad-hoc problem solving during unprecedented events.
Drive, influence, innovate and develop long-term strategic initiatives that shape the future of Apple’s supply chain and that aid in achieving Apple’s Sustainability goals of Carbon Neutrality throughout our supply chain by 2030.
Ensure customer and internal confidential data is protected throughout our supply chain.
Proficiency in computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and software development, enhancing problem-solving capabilities and project efficiency a plus.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Strong organizational and collaboration abilities
Confidence in managing ambiguity

jobs.title: Manager, Engineering Program Management — Customer Systems
jobs.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It's Apple's central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

At Apple, we don't just work. We innovate, create, and redefine what's possible. Every customer interaction is a chance to amaze, inspire, and connect, and by obsessing over the smallest details, we create experiences that leave a lasting impact.

The Customer Systems Platform Services team builds the next generation of contact center solutions at Apple. These platforms carry hundreds of millions of customer contacts a year across AppleCare and Retail. We are looking for an exceptional leader to build and lead our Engineering Program Management team: someone with a sharp technical mind, real financial and operational rigor, and the conviction to challenge how things have always been done.
As the Manager of Engineering Program Management for Customer Systems, you will lead a team of Engineering Program Managers delivering complex, multi-year platform initiatives across a global contact center footprint. You will own the portfolio roadmap and delivery, the health of the team behind it, and the portfolio's overall budget and total cost of ownership.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, and business, partnering daily with Engineering leaders, Solution Architects, business stakeholders, and finance partners to turn strategy into executable roadmaps across the business units we support.

Generative AI is central to how this team operates and what it delivers. You will drive adoption of GenAI and agentic tooling, so your team spends its time on judgment rather than administration, and you will be a credible partner to Engineering on the AI capabilities being built into the platform itself. Above all, we are looking for someone who challenges the norm, who looks at an accepted process, vendor roadmap, or architectural assumption and asks whether there is a fundamentally better way, then builds the analysis to prove it.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
10+ years of experience in technical program or engineering program management, delivering large, complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end.
5+ years of direct people management, including hiring, developing, and leading program managers or comparable senior individual contributors across geographically dispersed teams.
Demonstrated ownership of program or portfolio budgets, including forecasting, cost allocation, TCO, and ROI evaluation.
Comfortable owning accountability without full control of the resources delivering the work.
Hands-on experience applying Generative AI tools and LLMs to program execution in areas such as technical documentation, automated status reporting, data synthesis, or decision support.
Strong technical fluency; able to engage directly with engineers and architects, challenge assumptions, and dig into how the work is being done, not only whether it shipped.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven experience presenting to and influencing executive leadership.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience delivering large-scale platform migrations or legacy modernization while maintaining business continuity.
Experience with agentic AI, LLM-powered workflows, or conversational AI in a production customer-facing environment.
Experience partnering on vendor selection, contract negotiation, and licensing strategy for enterprise software.
Experience with capacity-based staffing models and onshore/offshore optimization.
Familiarity with data-driven decision-making; comfortable using usage, quality, and cost metrics to guide program direction.
Certifications in Scrum (CSM), Agile, or Project Management (PMP) are a plus.
Sharp analytical mindset and a bias toward simplifying rather than adding process.
Experience in the contact center domain: CCaaS platforms, telephony and routing architecture, workforce management, or agent-facing systems.

jobs.title: Materials Program Manager
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here. World Class operational excellence is a cornerstone of Apple's ability to consistently surprise and delight our customers. The WW Materials Program Manager plays a critical role in ensuring operational success for the Procurement organization. In this role, you will be responsible for materials readiness, availability, and visibility. This is a strategic supply chain role, interacting with our Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and internal core teams, encompassing critical component planning, allocation direction, supply flexibility modeling, and materials liability management. Do you have a passion for complex supply chain operations? We hope you will consider joining our team.
Do you enjoy seeing products come to life? The MPM will manage the CTB ("clear to build") process with suppliers and OEMs, ensuring that we have efficient process and clear visibility on our procurement strategy. Your successful ability to partner with OEMs and the sourcing team on material strategy will directly impact our product success.

- Clear-to-Build (CTB) Management: provide visibility to materials supply, highlighting projected coverage and constraints. CTB projections govern what the Supply-Demand Managers (SDM) can commit to customers and are a key input to revenue projections provided to our C-level executives.
- Partner with the CM to develop a model that incorporates the specific supply chain and materials flow details to project availability in support of our supply/demand goals.
- Create allocation strategies for constrained materials by developing models across factories, programs, and lines of business. Provide allocation direction to Global Supply Managers and Apple Suppliers.
- Challenge and influence Demand Planning and Strategic Sourcing teams to improve allocation and maximize revenue.
- Identify E & O and other material risk, recommend critical course of action to leadership, and own the efforts to mitigate liability to the business.
- Develop strategic roadmap for the phase‐out of obsolete parts and new product materials.
- Prepare and communicate critical Materials updates at weekly Sustaining Executive Program reviews;
maintain executive reports and summaries, providing accurate and timely data to leadership on a weekly
basis.
- Through a deep understanding of our commodity terms, ensure the logistical flow of materials necessary to meet production schedules, inventory control requirements, and ongoing material line support.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, Operations, or a related analytical field.
3+ years of professional experience in supply chain operations, materials management, procurement, or manufacturing planning.
Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in spreadsheet modeling (Excel/Numbers) for supply/demand matching, forecasting, and risk assessment.
Preferred qualifications:
Demonstrated experience managing Clear-to-Build (CTB), inventory allocation, or complex materials flow with Contract Manufacturers (CMs) or OEMs.
Ability to problem-solve and influence others through relationships and data.
Advanced modeling and predictive analytical skills; "Advanced User" of MS Excel with deep understanding of Excel techniques. VBA, SQL, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools a plus.
Professional experience with complex supply chain, technical expertise, or prior OEM management experience preferred.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to management required.
International experience and Mandarin, Japanese, Vietnamese language skills a plus.
MBA or Master's Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, or Operations Management preferred.
Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

Do you enjoy seeing products come to life? You will be responsible for developing the strategic direction, goals, objectives and key measurement systems to ensure the business goals are met. Specific responsibilities include, but not limited to:

Clear to build: Handle the CTB process, ensure the process is working smoothly and we have clear visibility on materials over a 26-week horizon. Partner with the CM’s and the GSMs (Global Supply Managers) on all identified material issues (including sub-tier supply chain) until issues are closed/resolved.

Logistics: Ensure the smooth flow of materials necessary to meet the production schedules, inventory control requirements, and on-going production line support. Make sure that we clearly understand the logistics requirements by commodity to enable an uninterrupted flow of materials.

Minimum qualifications:
5+ years of supporting corporations with the provision of renewable energy and/or emission reduction solutions (ex: in voluntary carbon markets) for fulfillment of compliance or voluntary objectives

Familiarity with environmental attribute certificates in energy and carbo
Collaborative team player. Ready to roll up sleeves, as needed, to support several projects and programs

At Apple, great ideas become products that touch the lives of billions. The people here don't just build technology, they create experiences that transform entire industries. It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation running through everything we do.

Apple's Wallet, Payments & Commerce (WPC) team is at the center of that work, redefining how people pay, access, and interact with financial services every day. Our work powers experiences like Apple Pay, Apple Cash, Tap to Pay, and connected services that enable commerce at a global scale. We are continuing to expand to new markets, new partners, and new capabilities, digitizing more of what people carry in their wallets and building the financial services platform of the future.

We are looking for a Manager of Engineering Program Management with a strong track record delivering large-scale, cross-functional engineering programs. You are a proven people leader who thrives on developing teams and driving complex initiatives from concept through delivery. This is a fast-paced environment where technical depth, collaboration, and execution excellence drive success.
This role leads program management and execution across a portfolio of Wallet, Payments and Commerce initiatives. You will partner directly with engineering and cross-functional teams across WPC and Apple Services to drive end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex programs.

As a people leader, you will mentor and grow a team of Engineering Program Managers, establish operational best practices, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence. You are as comfortable presenting to executives as you are engaging with engineering teams on technical details.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
7+ years of experience in technical program and project management, including managing a team of program managers.
Demonstrated ability to deliver large cross-functional programs and roadmaps, identify risks, and drive results.
Strong technical acumen, able to engage credibly with engineering teams on architecture, system design, and technical trade-offs.
Skilled at navigating ambiguity, building alignment across competing priorities, and leading teams to successful delivery.
Effective decision-maker who balances risks and benefits for the overall good of the organization.
Results-oriented and able to operate with minimal supervision in a cross-functional environment while managing program details and broader dependencies.
Experience influencing and building trust with partners and senior executive leadership to move programs forward.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience within payments, financial services, data, or analytics technology is highly desired.
Strong presentation, written, and verbal communication skills across a variety of audiences and organizational levels.
Ability to facilitate technical design and architecture discussions and translate technical concepts into actionable project plans.
Passion for mentoring and developing Engineering Program Managers, measuring success through the growth and impact of your team.
Flexibility to handle directional change and concurrently manage multiple priorities.

jobs.title: PMIC Engineering Program Manager
jobs.description:

We're seeking a Silicon Program Manager to drive PMIC development from architecture through mass production, combining program leadership with deep technical engagement.
In this individual contributor role, you'll own full silicon lifecycles for custom Power Management ICs and analog IP integrated into Apple SoCs in advanced process nodes. You'll coordinate cross-functional teams spanning silicon design, systems architecture, product engineering, and operations to deliver on aggressive schedules while resolving complex technical challenges. You won't just manage timelines— you'll lead technical discussions on power management architectures, evaluate design tradeoffs (efficiency, area, performance), and dive deep into analog/mixed-signal challenges to influence the technical direction across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
BS Degree in technical discipline and 3+ years of relevant experience .
Proven experience in SOC/VLSI Chip Design, ASIC Chip Design, Power Management Chip design or Technology process development.
Preferred qualifications:
Prior experience in Technical Program or Project Management, or Systems/Customer Support.
Experience working in a dynamic engineering environment, with strong real-time crisis management skills.
Proven ability to own and drive project execution using well-defined metrics.
Deep knowledge of ASIC and VLSI design flows, with experience leading silicon projects from concept to production.
Prior engineering experience with power management and PMICs is a plus.
Experience designing analog blocks—such as LDOs, bandgap references, ADCs, and buck/boost converters—is an advantage.
Experience with battery management products is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Program Manager, Claris
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Claris, a wholly owned subsidiary of Apple, empowers problem solvers at organizations of every size to create custom solutions. Our flagship product, FileMaker, has been in market for 40 years as part of the Apple family, and it's now joined by a new generation of high-growth products, some already in market and others on the way.

The Claris Marketing team is looking for a Senior Marketing Program Manager to drive the execution of our go-to-market programs. This role is a trusted operator for marketing leadership: someone who can take a major initiative from kickoff through delivery, orchestrate work across many teams, and clear the friction points that slow great work down. The right person knows marketing from the inside, understands how campaigns and launches come together, and loves turning strategy into clear plans that ship.
You'll plan and drive the marketing team's most important initiatives, from product launch kickoffs to long-running, multi-team programs. Our work spans two rhythms: milestone-driven launches and campaigns, and always-on content across email, social, paid media, and content marketing. You'll manage both, turning strategy into clear plans and keeping stakeholders and leadership aligned along the way.

You will also run the team's working rhythm, using agile practices, including planning sessions, reviews, and retrospectives that are structured and outcome-driven. You will turn each launch into a set of concrete improvements we apply to the next one.

Minimum qualifications:
7+ years of program or project management experience within a marketing organization
Experience with the go-to-market process, including campaign development, product launches, creative production, and coordination across email, social, paid, search, content marketing, and emerging channels
Experience partnering with senior leadership to plan and drive cross-functional initiatives
Experience delivering multi-team programs on time, from kickoff through completion
Preferred qualifications:
Bachelor's degree
Experience supporting launch readiness for software or technology products
Experience working in Scrum, including sprint planning, backlog management, reviews, and retrospectives
Experience managing work intake, prioritization, and capacity planning
Proficiency with Jira or similar tools
A team builder and trusted partner who builds relationships and creates the conditions for teams to collaborate effectively and deliver results
A continuous-improvement mindset, with a habit of documenting what works and applying it to future programs

jobs.title: Engineering Program Manager, Wireless Regulation
jobs.description:
Join Apple's Product Integrity team as an Engineering Program Manager (EPM) and play a pivotal role in bringing our groundbreaking products to the world. We are seeking a dynamic and strategically-minded program manager to lead global wireless certification, issues management, and resource planning for New Product Introduction (NPI) efforts across our ecosystem for Wireless products.
This role stands at the intersection of hardware engineering, global policy, and product compliance. As a key program manager, you will lead complex wireless certifications across products, but also navigate regulatory issues in a fast-changing and cutting-edge technology space. All the while, you will manage resources and capabilities that will help us meet project schedules and objectives efficiently and effectively. In addition, this role will play a key part in exploratory technologies, and help ensure clarity among engineering and cross-functional players as the regulatory landscape changes rapidly. Correspondingly, this role will work with internal and external partners to enable the timely certification of our products and technologies.

The ideal candidate is a cross-functional leader, tenacious problem-solver, and a builder of systems who thrives on bringing order out of complexity. If you are passionate about technology, working across myriad technical and policy-focused domains, and enabling new products that enrich lives, then this role may be for you!

Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
At least 7-10 years of experience in technical program management, issues project management, or a related role, within a hardware development or NPI environment. Equivalent experience in relevant fields to be considered on a case-by-case basis.
Proven experience in cross-functional leadership, with a demonstrated ability to influence, align, and drive teams without direct authority.
A strong track record of identifying and closing process gaps, and experience building scalable systems, frameworks, or processes from the ground up.
Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and navigate ambiguous challenges, and demonstrating a proclivity for action.
Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information from multiple sources, facilitate consensus-building, and drive alignment on outcomes—especially when managing competing priorities and tradeoffs.
Exceptional organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
Outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and regulatory concepts to diverse audiences.
Familiarity with the RF/wireless technology space and/or regulatory compliance processes.
Experience developing and executing strategic roadmaps in a global, multi-region environment.
Ability to embark on international travel, without limitation, up to 15% required.
Preferred qualifications:
Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience or MBA is a plus
Foreign language proficiency relevant in major markets desirable.
Experience with certification testing for consumer electronics bodies (e.g., FCC, ISED, CE RED).
Technical experience with core technologies such as WiFi, SAR, OTA, Bluetooth, EMC, and Cellular, and their uses in hardware products highly desirable.
A technical background in Electrical / Mechanical / Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is desirable.
Experience in high-volume manufacturing and product development are also desirable.

• Identify risks, develop mitigation strategies and facilitate conflict resolution
• Focused issue reporting and communication of program risks and status
• Technical understanding of system design and silicon validation planning

BS in electrical engineer or related engineering degree
3 year’s experience in hardware design and/or project management
Fluency in English

jobs.title: WW Business Operations Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

Here on the Apple Store Online team, we are responsible for Apple’s largest store. Our main goal is to deliver a magical, personal digital experience where customers can shop, buy and learn everything Apple, wherever they are. Each customer should feel like they are our only customer and our job is to set the bar for the experience they receive. To run such an extraordinary store, it takes extraordinary people, and we are looking for someone to help us do extraordinary things.

The Business Operations Analytics team is the objective intelligence layer for Apple's Retail Customer Care (RCC) organization — measuring performance, guiding decisions, and providing the trusted insights that drive revenue, reduce cost, and elevate customer experience across a global operation.

We are seeking an experienced analytics leader to own our Worldwide analytics function, leading a team of data scientists and analysts responsible for GenAI performance measurement, strategic analysis, and the consolidated business narrative for RCC leadership. As GenAI solutions begin handling customer interactions at scale, this leader will build the measurement frameworks that determine where automation adds value and where our Specialists remain essential. The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership, analytical rigor, and the ability to partner cross-functionally where data-driven decisions directly shape how millions of customers are served.
This role leads the Worldwide Analytics team within RCC Business Operations, owning three interconnected areas: GenAI performance measurement, strategic analysis for leadership, and the consolidated worldwide business narrative (quarterly reviews and executive reporting).

As GenAI solutions scale across voice and chat channels - handling customer interactions for hardware purchases and post-sale service - this leader will define how we measure their effectiveness. This includes building frameworks to evaluate containment, resolution quality, customer experience, and compliance, and providing the independent, objective view that guides where automation expands and where Specialists remain essential.

jobs.title: Governance & Operations Lead, Infrastructure & Planning
jobs.description:
Apple’s Platform Acceleration & Compute Efficiency (PACE) is a high-leverage team operating at the critical intersection of our ML organizations, underlying compute infrastructure, and core platform tooling. Our mission is to empower Apple’s software engineering teams with efficient, scalable compute. By driving out operational friction and optimizing the broader machine learning ecosystem, we directly accelerate the pace of development across the company.

We are seeking a founding Operations Lead with a passion for ML compute lifecycle management to build and own our governance and operations function. This is a ground-up opportunity to develop the roadmap and build a world-class, high level operations team. You will partner closely with tools and analytics leads to define the governance systems, telemetry frameworks, utilization dashboards, and analytical models that give PACE and Apple's ML leadership a clear, continuously updated picture of how compute is being used. Success for this role means zero project slips due to process, platform, or mis-prioritization. Mastery of this role means establishing and tracking key productivity metrics and proactively solving problems to keep those metrics consistently high. Your work will power core ML analytics both for internal development and inference serving.

Most operations roles involve endless runbooks. This role is for someone who is also an engineer and artist at heart. Your operations work will empower a high-leverage team to drive decisions that have a significant impact on Apple’s financial results.
- Own the daily operations of the systems you architect. You will design and oversee a scalable hub-and-spoke support model, spanning cross-functional tier-1 on-call teams, tier-2 team leads, and a dedicated tier-3 engineering escalation group that you will build and manage.
- Own and evolve PACE's governance tooling and related systems, ensuring that compute resource requests, allocations, and utilization data are accurately captured to support rapid, at-scale analysis.
- Bridge coverage gaps as Apple's ML ecosystem expands to new hardware (GPUs, TPUs, and custom silicon) and workloads (inference, on-device), balancing power, performance, cost, and compatibility.
- Partner with the Data & Analytics Lead to maintain the analytical layer, building the dashboards, reports, and automated alerts that surface efficiency opportunities and track infrastructure savings.
- Identify system anomalies and operational bottlenecks that degrade utilization and drive up costs, building financial impact models that translate technical metrics into actionable insights for leadership.
- Partner with Apple's ML engineering teams, delivering data-driven analytics to optimize the foundation models, inference workloads, and platform tooling that rely on your data for success.
- Design robust governance processes and automated operations engineered specifically to meet Apple-scale ML demands.
- Partner to produce strategic analyses that inform executive decisions on ML compute investment, allocation, and strategy, directly influencing Apple's ML growth and feature development.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
BS in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
5+ years in a governance/operations role, data engineering, analytics engineering, technical program management, or in a large-scale compute or cloud environment
Organized, process-oriented, and comfortable owning operational systems other people depend on daily
Strong cross-functional experience working with capable engineers, managers, EPMs, and leaders
Proven experience designing and operating complex systems and processes from the ground up
AI-fluent and capable of quickly adapting to AI workflows and empowerment
Direct experience managing SRE and hierarchical technical support systems
SQL and experience building analytical dashboards or data products (Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or similar)
Experience designing data models or telemetry schemas for infrastructure, capacity, or utilization data
Ability to translate raw technical metrics into clear business narratives for both engineers and executives
Preferred qualifications:
Experience with Python for data analysis (pandas, notebooks) or lightweight pipeline development
Familiarity with ML training infrastructure concepts: GPU utilization, training throughput, and scheduling efficiency mean, even if you have not optimized them directly
Prior experience in FinOps, capacity planning, cloud cost management, or IT governance
Experience building or operating data analytics systems
Background in automated alerting or anomaly detection for infrastructure metrics

jobs.title: Sales - Technology Strategist, Strategic Accounts, Philippines
jobs.description:
The people here don’t just build products — they create the kind of technology and experiences that can change entire industries. It is the diversity of our people and their ideas that drives the innovation behind everything we do. Join us and help leave the world better than we found it.

At Apple we work with some of the most ambitious organizations in the world. We help customers rethink how their people work, how technology can improve their business, and how our platforms and ecosystem can become part of that journey.

The Technology Strategist is a trusted technical advisor to some of Apple’s most strategic enterprise customers in Southeast Asia. You will work with business and technology leaders to turn organizational ambition into a clear technical vision, architecture, and adoption roadmap.

The role combines enterprise architecture, executive advisory, and hands-on technical leadership. You will help customers understand emerging technologies, simplify complex decisions, modernize their technology environments, and create secure, scalable experiences with Apple at their core.
Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and senior business leaders, becoming a strategic advisor on technology and innovation.

Help customers define a multi-year technical vision that connects their business ambition with their enterprise architecture, operating model, workforce strategy, and investment priorities.

Assess the customer’s current technology landscape across identity, security, device management, networking, cloud services, applications, data, AI, and support operations.

Translate that assessment into a practical roadmap, identifying architectural dependencies, integration requirements, technical debt, security considerations, and opportunities for simplification.

Develop reference architectures and integration patterns for Apple platforms within complex, heterogeneous enterprise environments.

Apply well-architected principles across security and privacy, reliability and resilience, operational excellence, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability.

Help customers rationalize their technology and application portfolios, understand architectural trade-offs, and make informed decisions based on business value, risk, user experience, and total cost of ownership.

Lead executive briefings, technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, and design reviews.

Demystify complex and emerging technologies—including AI—and explain their implications clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Partner with Apple sales, engineering, product, security, services, and partner teams to remove technical barriers and move customers from vision to scaled adoption.

Maintain a clear technical account plan with agreed priorities, milestones, success measures, risks, and owners.

Represent the voice of the customer within Apple, providing insight into enterprise requirements, technology trends, and opportunities for innovation.

What success looks like:
- Customers have an agreed technical vision and a practical roadmap connected to their business priorities.

- Executive ambition is translated into secure, scalable, and well-architected technical decisions.

- Technical barriers are identified early and resolved through clear ownership and cross-functional collaboration.

- Demonstrations and pilots lead to measurable adoption at scale.

- Apple becomes a trusted part of the customer’s broader enterprise technology strategy.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Strong technical depth across enterprise architecture, cloud and hybrid environments, identity and access management, cybersecurity, endpoint management, networking, application integration, and lifecycle operations.

Strong knowledge of identity and security concepts, including federation, SSO, MFA, conditional access, Zero Trust, PKI and certificates, endpoint security, data protection, and security governance.

Experience designing solutions that integrate devices and platforms with identity providers, MDM or UEM platforms, security tools, cloud services, SaaS applications, APIs, and line-of-business systems.

Strong consultative skills and the ability to uncover customer needs, challenge assumptions constructively, and connect technology decisions to business outcomes.

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to make complex technology understandable without oversimplifying it.

Confidence engaging senior executives while maintaining credibility with architects, security teams, engineers, and operations teams.

Ability to influence across complex organizations and coordinate multiple internal, customer, and partner stakeholders.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience deploying and integrating Apple platforms in large enterprise environments.

Knowledge of macOS, iOS, iPadOS, Apple Business Manager, automated device enrollment, declarative device management, Platform SSO, and Apple platform security.

Enterprise architecture, cloud, identity, security, or device-management certifications.

Experience working in regulated industries or complex multinational organizations.

Understanding of AI architectures, including cloud, hybrid, private, and on-device approaches.

Experience developing business cases using adoption outcomes, risk reduction, employee experience, and total economic impact.

jobs.title: AIML - Senior Operations Program Manager - Responsible AI and Safety
jobs.description:
At Apple, we don't just build products — we build experiences fueled by world-class data. The Responsible AI team is looking for a senior operations program manager to own the partnerships, vendor relationships, and data operations behind our Safety Evaluation and Red Teaming programs, scaling the human-labeled data, workforce, and localizationinfrastructure that generative AI features across our Software ecosystem.
In this role, you will manage Apple's relationship with internal crowd as well as a portfolio of external vendor partners spanning evaluation, red-teaming, and data generation. You will own how this work gets resourced, scoped, and executed — from statements of work and workforce calibration to quality audits and ongoing partner performance — ensuring these partnerships can scale reliably as safety evaluation needs grow across products, features, and markets.

You will also own the feedback loop and establish the processes that connect Red-Teaming, Evaluation, and Post-Ship Insights groups. Findings surfaced through red-teaming and evaluation need to inform what we monitor once features ship, and post-ship signals need to flow back into how we prioritize and design future red-teaming and evaluation coverage. You will build and operate the mechanisms — shared reporting, recurring syncs, and closed-loop tracking — that keep these three functional areas working from a single, current picture of risk rather than in isolation. Ensuring compliant and timely reporting across Apple Intelligence features is a key element of this role.

You will shape the tools and infrastructure roadmap needed to power these functions. This includes maintaining clear, current documentation of processes, systems, and data flows across these functional areas, and identifying and prioritizing the tooling and infrastructure investments needed to support them as they scale — partnering with engineering and technical stakeholders to translate operational needs into build requirements.

Lastly, you will also drive the operational scaling of our data infrastructure: how we manage, store, and govern the human-labeled goldsets that underpin safety benchmarking and LLM-judge validation, and how those pipelines extend to new languages, markets, and cultural contexts.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in a related field
5+ years of experience in vendor/partner management, data operations, or program management, ideally supporting ML/AI evaluation, annotation, or data labeling programs
Demonstrated experience managing external vendor relationships and/or internal annotation operations partnerships at scale, including statements of work, budget, and performance management
Experience scaling human-labeled data pipelines, including dataset creation, quality calibration, storage, and governance
Experience standing up or scaling operations across multiple international markets, including working with multilingual and multicultural vendor workforces
Experience coordinating across functionally distinct but interdependent teams to close feedback loops and keep shared priorities aligned
Experience owning documentation and translating operational needs into tooling or infrastructure roadmaps, partnering with engineering to scope and prioritize build work
Strong ability to think strategically about operational tradeoffs while managing multiple concurrent initiatives in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Proven track record managing budgets and vendor relationships at scale
Proficiency with data tools (e.g., SQL, spreadsheets/BI tools) sufficient to track vendor performance, cost, and data quality metrics
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to translate operational risk and status for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Preferred qualifications:
Experience managing vendor or annotation partnerships specifically for AI safety evaluation, red-teaming, or Responsible AI programs
Familiarity with goldset design, labeling guidelines, or LLM-judge/evaluation workflows sufficient to partner effectively with technical teams
Experience building internationalization or localization operations for data labeling or evaluation programs
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to AI safety and content risk across international markets
Demonstrated success building operations or vendor programs from the ground up, including establishing new processes or partner relationships
Executive presence and experience presenting operational risk assessments and scaling plans to senior leadership

Leverage established regulatory relationships and expertise to provide strategic support for AI features regulatory interfaces, algorithm filings, and safety assessments.

Minimum qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Law, Public Policy, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
