The ability to exert influence in a highly matrixed organization.
The ability to maintain a focus on simplicity while handling complex challenges.
The ability to recognize, attract, and develop talent.
Excellent analytical and quantitative skills.

jobs.title: Security Business Partner Lead - Product Ops & Supply Chain, AIS
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.

The AIS Business Partner Lead - Product Ops & Supply Chain will act as the security liaison between the Apple Information Security (AIS) organization and Apple's global Product Operations teams. This role is critical in understanding, translating, and delivering the security needs of this complex and dynamic business area, which encompasses manufacturing systems, supply chain infrastructure, logistics platforms, operational technology, factory operations, and global supplier networks.

This individual will ensure AIS programs and service solutions meet operational demands while driving strategic initiatives to enhance overall security posture. A key aspect of this role is to ensure the shared priorities of both AIS and Product Operations are clearly understood, effectively translated into actionable plans, and ultimately met, fostering a seamless and secure operational environment for Apple's supply chain. They will be responsible for using their technical acumen to lead threat models and architecture reviews for Product Operations systems. Collaborating across AIS and Product Operations teams, this leader will develop tailored security roadmaps, ensure information security service delivery, and provide executive-level support to these teams.
You will work as part of the Apple Information Security - Business Engagement team, helping drive the day-to-day security needs of our Product Operations partners, while delivering the overall strategies and services of Apple Information Security.

* Serve as the primary AIS point of contact for Product Operations & Supply Chain teams, developing a deep understanding of manufacturing systems, supply chain infrastructure, operational technology, and global logistics to identify and address security risks.

* Collaborate with AIS service teams to ensure security offerings align with Product Operations needs and priorities, proactively identifying gaps and opportunities.

* Translate Product Operations business requirements to technical requirements that drive AIS engineering decisions and service delivery.

* Create and maintain comprehensive security roadmaps tailored to Product Operations, accounting for manufacturing cycles, supply chain constraints, and operational realities.

* Provide subject matter expertise on security advisement, ensuring alignment with enterprise security standards and policies while understanding operational constraints.

* Partner with embedded security teams and individuals across Product Operations to support risk management and mitigation strategies.

* Drive cross-functional collaboration to resolve escalations and ensure timely resolution of security incidents impacting manufacturing or supply chain operations.

* Oversee and deliver threat models and security architecture reviews for Product Operations systems, manufacturing infrastructure, and supply chain platforms.

* Represent AIS in Product Operations executive meetings, providing updates, insights, and strategic guidance to foster strong security culture and alignment.

* Measure and communicate quantifiable impacts of AIS security services with Product Operations stakeholders.

* Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of AIS services in meeting supply chain and manufacturing business needs, recommending improvements and advocating for Product Operations interests within AIS to drive continuous improvement in service delivery.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
10+ years of experience in Information Security or related security fields.
8+ years of experience in securing large operations, supply chain, or manufacturing environments.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of supply chain processes and technologies, with a focus on identifying and mitigating technical security risks.
Extensive experience with security threat modeling and architecture reviews for operational technology and manufacturing systems.
Expertise in security risk management, governance, and compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001).
Expertise in SaaS security and cloud platforms used in supply chain operations.
Expertise in automating and improving security processes and applications.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective cross-functional relationships, including at the executive level.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
Preferred qualifications:
Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Information Security, or a related discipline.
Experience or exposure to working with Managed Service Security Providers (MSSP).
Experience with operational technology (OT) security and industrial control systems.
Knowledge of manufacturing systems and infrastructure security best practices.
Experience with global supply chain security programs and supplier risk management.
Understanding of logistics platforms and distribution network security.
Track record of successfully managing security escalations and delivering quantifiable security improvements.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

jobs.title: Data Products & Business Intelligence Lead - Wallet, Payments & Commerce
jobs.description:
Design and build the next generation of analytical data products for Apple’s Wallet, Payments & Commerce — from instrumentation specs to last-mile datasets and interactive Visualization. Serves as a hands-on Data Product & BI Lead, driving end-to-end delivery of scalable, privacy-first analytics platforms that power trusted insights across the organization.

Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
Our culture is about getting things done iteratively and rapidly, with open feedback and debate along the way; we believe analytics is a team sport, but we strive for independent decision-making and taking smart risks. Our team collaborates deeply with partners across product, design, engineering and business teams: our mission is to drive innovation by providing the business and data scientist partners best in class systems and tools to make decisions that improve the customer experience. This will include leveraging large and complex data sources, helping derive actionable insights, delivering dynamic and intuitive decision tools, and bringing our data to life via interactive self serve decision tooling with an eye to meet high standards of trust, accuracy, legal and privacy compliance.

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated team player, skilled in a broad set of data product tools and techniques with a strong sense of Apple design philosophy. The candidate will have the ability to adapt and learn quickly, provide results with limited direction, and choose the best possible path forward at all times.

This is a rare opportunity to define the analytics foundation for one of Apple’s most strategically important business areas — Wallet, Payments & Commerce. You won’t be maintaining the status quo; you’ll be building the future — from metrics architecture to AI-driven decision intelligence — at a scale and quality standard that only Apple demands.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field or equivalent experience
10+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying next-generation data and AI-powered analytical products.
3+ years as a senior IC leading the development of data products, AI-enabled analytics, and visualizations across multiple lines of business.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Scala, Python with hands-on experience in data pipeline tools (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow), CI/CD practices, and version control.
Strong understanding of data warehousing, dimensional data modeling, semantic/metrics layers, and metric standardization.
Experience applying Generative AI/LLMs and agentic AI patterns to analytics use cases such as insight generation, natural-language data exploration, and workflow automation.
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across engineering and business teams
Excellent Executive communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences
Preferred qualifications:
Familiarity with digital payments or fintech data — transaction metrics, funnel analytics, financial KPIs
Familiarity with AI-driven analytics / conversational BI
Knowledge of data governance, data cataloging, and metadata management
Experience working closely with data engineering and platform teams to align on data models, and infrastructure/platform requirements
Proven record in leading junior engineers to build metrics or BI foundation

jobs.title: Global Business Development - Head of US Carrier & Global Bundles and Segmentation Partnerships
jobs.description:
Come be a part of one of the fastest growing businesses at Apple. Apple’s Services team is seeking an experienced, thoughtful and entrepreneurial leader with a passion for media and entertainment to help grow its Services businesses.
You will play a leadership role in advancing the global growth strategy for Apple Services by identifying, developing, and scaling strategic distribution and partnership opportunities. You will lead the evaluation, structuring, and negotiation of complex commercial agreements while helping to shape and prioritize the platform capabilities required to enable long-term business growth. This role requires a strategic, highly motivated leader with strong business acumen, exceptional attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams—including Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Business Development—as well as external partners to deliver initiatives that support Apple’s strategic and commercial objectives. The successful candidate is a proactive self-starter with a proven track record of building, negotiating, and managing complex third-party partnerships that expand the distribution and marketing of Apple’s media and entertainment services. You are comfortable influencing across organizations, balancing competing priorities, and driving results in a fast-paced, dynamic, and evolving business environment.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
15+ years of progressive leadership experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or commercial management within the media, entertainment, telecommunications, or digital services industries.
Demonstrated success building and managing strategic partnerships with U.S. wireless carriers, MVPDs, financial services organizations, and other third-party media and entertainment platforms.
Proven experience leading, developing, and inspiring high-performing business development teams in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Deep understanding of the U.S. wireless carrier ecosystem, over-the-top (OTT) media landscape, and digital subscription business models.
Established executive-level network and a strong track record of influencing and building relationships with senior leaders across the telecommunications, media, and entertainment industries.
Extensive experience leading complex commercial negotiations, structuring strategic agreements, and driving successful outcomes with external partners and cross-functional stakeholders within a large, matrixed organization.
Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate a clear strategic vision while leading broad cross-functional teams to successfully execute high-impact business initiatives.
Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance long-term strategy and operational execution.
Preferred qualifications:
MBA or other advanced degree in Business, Finance, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated passion for building and scaling global, multi-million-dollar business partnerships and strategic growth initiatives.
Exceptional track record of business development, partnership management, and commercial negotiations resulting in measurable business growth.
Strong financial acumen with extensive experience developing business cases, financial models, and commercial frameworks to support strategic decision-making.
Outstanding executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across functions, organizational levels, and global teams.
Proven project and program management capabilities, with exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
Deep experience working with or within U.S. wireless carriers, global streaming media services, and subscription-based digital content businesses.
Demonstrated ability to thrive in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment while driving alignment across Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Engineering, and Operations.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager – Tap to Pay on iPhone & Apple Wallet (Wallet, Payments and Commerce)
jobs.description:
The Wallet, Payments, and Commerce team is dedicated to delivering our vision to bring innovative commerce experiences to merchants with Tap to Pay on iPhone and Apple Pay, and to replace the traditional wallet and deliver financial and wallet services that empower consumers, and provide an incredible user experience.

At Apple, we bring together exceptional people to achieve their life’s best work. If you are an outstanding Business Development professional who is technically-minded and wants to drive initiatives with autonomy and make a meaningful impact, this could be the role for you.

In this role, you will lead business development for Tap to Pay on iPhone in Australia + New Zealand, developing strategies and implementing actions to drive adoption and usage of the service in Australia + New Zealand. Additionally, you will drive acceptance of Wallet Services and Apple Pay through payment platforms.

You'll manage partner implementations and relationships, and contribute to the adoption of new features and services. Collaboration is key, as you'll work cross-functionally with Technical, Product, Operations, Legal, and Marketing teams within Apple, as well as with our ecosystem of partners, including card networks, acquirers, payment service providers, commerce platforms and merchants.

We are looking for someone who is technically curious, dynamic, results-oriented, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. If you are passionate about innovation and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we encourage you to apply.

This is a full-time role within the Wallet, Payments, and Commerce team, based in our Sydney office.
Lead business development for Tap to Pay on iPhone in Australia + New Zealand, including partner acquisition and onboarding and driving growth and optimisation with existing partners

Develop strategies to drive and scale the acceptance of Wallet services (including membership passes, ticketing, and new services under development) and Apple Pay through payment platforms.
Establish, develop, and nurture strong business relationships with payment providers, merchants, utilities, financial service providers, carriers and other key players in the acceptance value chain.
Lead all aspects of partner relationships, from day-to-day management to the introduction of new projects and features.
Drive partner implementation of solutions and features, providing technical and project management support and ensuring all product requirements are met to the highest standards.
Monitor, track, and optimize the performance of key performance indicators (KPIs).
Collaborate with Apple Product and Engineering teams to influence the product roadmap, leveraging insights gained from the market, partners, and customers.

Provide clear and concise communications to business leaders within Apple and partner organizations.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
5-10+ years of experience in business development or partnership roles.
Prior experience in technical implementations would be preferable
Preferred qualifications:
Demonstrated experience in payments or related digital services, along with knowledge of the local payment and wallet services acceptance landscape.
Experience leading business development, ideally within payments or related services, including customer acquisition and partnership management.
Excellent judgment, presence, and interpersonal skills; experience working effectively with a wide range of cross-functional teams, both internal and external.
Self-motivated and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment, comfortable managing evolving priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
Strong problem-solving, negotiation, influencing, conflict resolution, and decision-making abilities.
Analytical skills, with the ability to assess opportunities from multiple perspectives (both quantitative and qualitative), and drive appropriate performance tracking and analysis.
A collaborative team player who is passionate about achieving outstanding results.
Willingness to travel regionally on occasion.

jobs.title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Lead, App Store
jobs.description:
At Apple, we believe in the power of apps to enrich people's lives. The App Store is the world's most vibrant and innovative app marketplace, connecting developers with hundreds of millions of users every week.

We are seeking a highly motivated, strategic and analytical Senior Lifecycle Marketing Lead to join our App Store team. In this role, you will be the foremost expert on the App Store user journey. You will be responsible for deeply understanding the end-to-end user lifecycle, identifying untapped opportunities, and championing the creation of new experiences that drive meaningful, sustainable growth for the business. Sitting at the intersection of product, marketing, data science, and AI, you will orchestrate strategies across Apple's owned channels and beyond. By leveraging user signals and advanced machine learning models, you will help us deliver the right message and experience to the right user at the perfect time.
As a Senior Growth Strategist for the App Store, your responsibilities will include:

Lifecycle Mastery & Signal Strategy: Map the diverse journeys of App Store users and define the strategy for how we capture and utilize user signals. Identify friction points and moments of delight to uncover opportunities for intelligent, automated interventions.

AI-Driven Experience Innovation: Partner closely with Product, Design, and ML teams to conceptualize and build new features and onboarding flows. Leverage artificial intelligence and predictive modeling to naturally drive user engagement, discovery , and lifetime value.

Cross-Channel Orchestration: Design, launch, and scale comprehensive growth strategies across owned and external channels. Ensure a unified, highly personalized user experience that dynamically adapts to user behavior using real-time signals.

Model Optimization & Data Strategy: Collaborate with Data Science to define the inputs and objectives for growth models. Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) that tie model performance and user experience improvements directly to meaningful business growth.

Experimentation & Scaling: Lead a rigorous culture of experimentation. Design and implement A/B tests across lifecycle campaigns and AI-driven product flows to continuously optimize performance, relevance, and user satisfaction.

Cross-Functional Execution: Act as the connective tissue between Marketing, Product, AI/ML, and Data teams, driving complex, multi-channel initiatives from ideation to global execution.

Strategic Storytelling: Develop compelling business cases and strategic narratives to secure buy-in from senior leadership for new growth investments, technical capabilities, and lifecycle initiatives.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
10+ years of experience in growth strategy , lifecycle marketing, product management, or a related field, preferably within the tech, media, or mobile app industry .
Deep expertise in mapping and managing the user lifecycle (acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and win-back).
Proven track record of working closely with Machine Learning, AI, and Data Engineering teams; deep understanding for how to harness user signals, predictive models, and AI to power personalization at scale.
Proven ability to identify gaps in the user journey and translate those insights into the development of new, high-impact product experiences or marketing interventions.
Extensive experience orchestrating cohesive, data-driven growth initiatives across owned channels (e.g., in-app messaging, push notifications, email) and cross-channel touchpoints.
Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate complex behavioral data and model outputs into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with a track record of influencing and collaborating seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Design, AI/ML, and Editorial teams.
Deep understanding of multi-sided marketplace dynamics, with the ability to balance and optimize the value exchange between customers, developers, and Apple to drive sustainable, ecosystem-wide growth.
Excellent presentation, written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate a strong point of view clearly and succinctly to senior executives and individual contributors.
Exceptional relationship-building and interpersonal skills, including communication skills to form consensus of opinion.
Ability to work collaboratively under pressure, with proven experience working on complex, international, large-scale and time-critical projects.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience with app marketplace platforms, with a strong understanding of app discovery, distribution, and developer ecosystems.
Proven understanding of integrating Product, Design, Business, Marketing, Engineering and other cross-functional stakeholders to clarify program goals, strategy and execution.
Sensibility to cut through ambiguity and find the path forward despite uncertainty or challenges.

jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
Marketing Communications (Marcom) is the creatively-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world-class communications across all media and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.

The Brand team drives integrated campaigns and product launches across cross-functional teams. We are the voice and protectors of the Apple brand. We’re natural collaborators and connectors, bringing all teams together in pursuit of the best work.

We are looking for a seasoned, highly capable Brand Manager to oversee the direction and integration of marketing campaigns, as well as the strategic marketing efforts required to drive local market opportunities and challenges for your assigned product lines.
In this role, you will navigate a dynamic environment where deep collaboration and a passion for excellence intersect. You will partner closely with Interactive, Channel, Retail, and Advertising teams, while nurturing key relationships with Product Marketing, PR, and Sales. By acting as the central point of contact for product launches, you will represent regional needs to worldwide teams and ensure messaging consistency across all deliverables, ultimately shaping industry-defining work.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
8+ years of experience managing integrated marketing campaigns within a creative agency or client organization.
Experience managing creative and production agency partners.
Experience managing cross-functional workflows and multi-stakeholder project lifecycles.
Fluency in written and spoken Chinese and English, with experience presenting concepts to local and global executives.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience crafting presentation decks and delivering narratives to senior leadership.
Experience aligning strategic positioning and executing integrated marketing plans across diverse business groups.
Ability to establish trust and influence across multiple partners in a matrixed global organization.
Experience balancing the needs of a creatively driven organization with an analytical approach to marketing.
Interest in popular culture, consumer trends, and emerging media or technology.

jobs.title: Apple Pay and Apple Wallet Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Apple, we don’t just build great products — we create a kind of wonder that revolutionizes entire industries. It’s the diversity of our people and their ideas driving the innovation in everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple and help us leave the world better than we found it!

The Wallet, Payments, and Commerce (WPC) team is dedicated to delivering a suite of services and platforms that allow users to easily, privately, securely, and responsibly digitize their wallet. Leveraging our main frameworks, Apple Pay (for payments) and Apple Wallet (for a wide range of other wallet style functionality), our partners can offer simple, private, and secure experiences that build on our goals to safeguard our users' information and to protect their financial health.
We are looking for Apple Pay Marketing Manager to develop and drive innovative activation campaigns and communications across the whole stack of Apple Pay and Apple Wallet services such as in-store payments, online payments, transit, identity and more.

In this role, you will be responsible for contributing to build strategic marketing plans for Japan, and potentially Korea, and implementing the projects from concept through delivery, in collaboration with a cross-functional worldwide Apple team, external agencies and partners like physical and online merchants, banks, issuers, tech and transit companies.

You are passionate about changing people’s lives for the better and believe that marketing has the power to do so by telling the right messages. You also enjoy working with partners to build an all-win scenario for everyone involved while crafting innovative and effective programs which not only drive business metrics but also tell the story of “Why Apple Pay and Apple Wallet matter” to consumers.

We believe the role would place you in a highly-energized environment with some of the most creative individuals in the industry where you would be inspired to share your years of experience along with providing extraordinary support for the team.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
5+ years experience in consumer marketing
A proven record of consumer communication building experience from scratch brief to execution, dealing with ambiguity
Ability to manage and lead external creative agencies
Strong analytical skills
Business Level Proficiency English and Japanese
Preferred qualifications:
Proficiency in Korean is a plus
Master of Business Administration degree is a plus
Multiple experiences of leading successful consumer campaigns such as new product launches, brand campaigns, and/or tactical promotions
BtoBtoC marketing experience or collaboration marketing experience with multiple partners in complicated interest conflict environment
Ability to see a project as a part of entire plan and to define clear goals of each project to achieve the ultimate objective
Strong negotiation skill

jobs.title: Leader Marketing Strategy, Brand - Apple TV
jobs.description:
At Apple TV, our Marketing team creates world-class campaigns that connect people with high-quality and meaningful stories on Apple TV while building awareness and love for our brand. We approach every aspect of our campaigns, from strategic vision to creative execution, with innovation and excellence in mind, ensuring that every touchpoint is thoughtfully designed. Our highly collaborative team works closely with teams across Apple, as well as with agencies, studios, and talent to generate buzz and put Apple TV at the center of culture around the world. Apple TV is seeking a leader for Global Brand Marketing Strategy, reporting into the Global Apple TV Marketing Strategy Director.
The ideal candidate has a demonstrated track record with driving growth in a subscription business model both in the US and internationally. This leader must be an innovative thinker who can put our brand in the cultural zeitgeist, while also understanding the business metrics to create campaigns that result in subscriber acquisition and retention. To complement our Content Marketing team, we are looking for a leader to help develop and strengthen the brand marketing strategy for Apple TV to continue growing our platform and business. This leader must be incredibly collaborative and cross-functional, understanding all touch points of bringing a brand to life in marketing while partnering across the business teams, product design teams, local in-market teams, PR, Creative, Media, Operations, and more.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
10+ years of experience in driving strategic campaigns for brands, with particular expertise in streaming and/or entertainment environments.
Minimum of 5 years of people management experience, building and leading teams.
Experience of subscription business lifecycle metrics and measurement.
International experience and/or experience working with international teams.
Preferred qualifications:
Proven marketing leader with an established track record and career progression, with demonstrated ability to collaborate and partner cross-functionally across Business strategy and growth, Marketing, PR/Communications, Content, and other internal partner teams.
Proven experience running multi touchpoint 360 degree brand campaigns, from strategy to execution, both paid and organic, and delivering desired outcomes.
Excellent written and verbal communication. Able to convey ideas simply and clearly in interpersonal, presentation, and document form.
Brings a highly strategic and analytical approach to decisions and problem-solving.

jobs.title: Global Sourcing and Supply Manager
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, creative ideas have a way of becoming wonderful products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Acting as a key interface among Worldwide Operations Team, strategic suppliers and contract manufacturers, APO GSSM is responsible for managing strategic and tactical initiatives of the Apple supply chain. This role will focus on a specific commodity and will play a critical role in the overall success of the Apple Operation.
- Act as resident expert in an assigned commodity

- Collaborate with Worldwide Team to plan manufacturing capacity, prepare supply chain for new product ramps, lead timely actions to resolve supply issues and provide accurate risk assessments and supply projections

- Manage forecast and supply, ensure supply chain flexibility to minimize risks

- Manage and develop suppliers to maintain industry leading quality, delivery and cost

- Develop and maintain professional and productive business partnership with suppliers

- Work with Apple cross-functional teams and supply chain to achieve business goals and objectives

- Spot improvement opportunities in supply chain and work to execute key initiatives and strategies

- Participate in supplier evaluation and selection
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
BS/BA degree; MBA is a plus but not required

English, Mandarin fluency. Other language fluency a plus but not required

Operations/supply chain management or commodity management experience is a plus
Preferred qualifications:
Quick learner

Demonstrated ability to drive and deliver strategic business initiatives

Outstanding analytical capabilities

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Ability to work cross functionally in a dynamic environment - individually and as a member of a team

Ability to handle different and competing priorities

High level of personal and professional integrity

Strong work ethic with a high degree of flexibility

Familiar with Python/Tableau, data analysis etc. is a plus

Travel: Frequent travel might be required during some parts of the year, depending on the commodities

jobs.description:

- Strategic Initiatives: Formation and execution of wireless / RF supply chain strategy to advance team wide priorities including cost modeling, new supplier development, and emerging technology investigations through deep engineering collaboration.
- Scalability: As Gen AI capabilities advance, leverage AI Agents and tools to keep up with increasing complexity and growing business needs without degrading quality or understanding.
- Business continuity planning : Continuously see around corners by anticipating potential risks and establishing sourcing criteria to proactively mitigate risks in a dynamic market environment.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Bachelors’ degree
Minimum of 8 years of experience in supply chain design and optimization, supplier sourcing and procurement negotiation, supply management and operations, cost modeling and financial analysis
5+ years of management experience
Preferred qualifications:
Strong procurement/supply chain experience with a proven track record of success
MBA or M.S. degree a plus

jobs.title: Senior Services Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation running through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.

Apple’s Services—including the App Store, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV, and many others—are among the most dynamic and widely used in the world. As the regulatory landscape continues to evolve, our organization requires proactive, technically rigorous leadership on the ground in China to ensure our platforms navigate emerging obligations while preserving product integrity and user trust.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager based in China to lead an in-country team responsible for driving strategic China regulatory, compliance, and partner engineering work within Apple’s Services organization. In this role, you will serve as the senior Services regulatory and compliance leader in China, managing a team that engages directly with regulators and auditors. You will develop strategy and requirements, while bridging communication with our global teams.
Apple operates services in China at a scope and scale unlike any other multinational company. The challenges we face have no playbook. Our work is exceptionally complex, ambiguous, and vital to Apple’s operations. This role is focused on how expanding data, cybersecurity, and internet regulations in China impact Apple’s services, specifically driving the practical application of regulations into systems architecture, data governance, data export, and content operations.

In response to these regulatory and compliance obligations, Apple maintains strategic and operating partnerships for several of our services in China. This role also owns in-country engagement with those partners for regulatory and compliance, collaborating closely with local operating partners, local Apple teams, and US engineering leadership to ensure our services operate reliably and securely, while maintaining compliance with evolving rules.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Direct experience representing technology/engineering organizations in regulatory engagements, government assessments, or technical audits with Chinese regulatory authorities or designated assessment bodies, with direct familiarity managing frameworks such as Multi-Level Protection Scheme (MLPS) or Cross-border Data Transfer Security Assessments.

8+ years of experience leading complex technical programs or engineering initiatives in cloud, distributed platforms, or internet services.

4+ years of formal people management experience, successfully leading and developing senior technical or technical program management professionals.

4+ years of dedicated experience developing technical, operational, and business requirements based on legal, regulatory, cybersecurity, or data governance requirements.

Demonstrated technical competence evaluating services architectures, backend data flows, cloud infrastructure, or data residency/storage models.

Proven track record managing and negotiating complex technical, operational, or business relationships with external strategic partners, platform operators, or service providers.

Complete bilingual professional fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English (written and spoken), with proven mastery leading technical reviews, negotiating complex issues, and presenting to executive and government audiences in both languages.

Demonstrated excellence in communicating with and influencing senior leadership across global engineering, legal, business, product, and operations organizations across time zones.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience with local cloud infrastructure, third-party data center operations, and joint operating models in China.

Experience building and scaling an in-region technical compliance or regulatory engineering team within a global technology company.

Direct experience handling regulatory filings and compliance reviews for internet information services, algorithms, or content delivery systems in China.

Deep domain experience with consumer internet platforms, cloud infrastructure, or identity/account architectures operating at massive global scale.

Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical technical leadership experience.

jobs.title: Client Partner Manager, Apple Ads
jobs.description:
At Apple, we believe in the power of technology to enrich people’s lives. Everything we build is designed to empower people, including our advertising platform. We deliver ads in a way that benefits both customers and advertisers—helping people discover content, supporting creators, and protecting and respecting everyone’s privacy. Our technology makes advertising possible on the App Store, Maps, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV. We help developers and marketers of all sizes promote and monetize their work while also helping people around the world discover apps and media through the App Store. Our display ads on Apple News and Stocks let advertisers promote their products alongside trusted content from the world’s best journalists. Sponsorship integrations and experiences in live sports on Apple TV help advertisers connect with passionate fans. Everything we do is with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone.

Strategic-minded, hands-on leader with extensive management experience in running a growing and evolving sales organization in a cross-functional environment.

jobs.title: AppleCare Technologies BPR Project Manager, Service Supply Chain
jobs.description:

Do you develop strong relationships, build trust, and drive outcomes through technical credibility and influence? Do you communicate openly and clearly with engineers and business leaders alike, collaborate enthusiastically, and value a culture of healthy debate grounded in data and design thinking?

AppleCare Technologies Business Process Reengineering (BPR) is responsible for delivering cross-functional systems projects across all AppleCare business areas, including Sales, Service, Support, Supply Chain, and Logistics. We build strong technical relationships across the company and stitch AppleCare systems and processes enterprise-wide, from hardware repair engineering and diagnostics platforms to service quality and customer systems.

As a BPR Project Manager you will plan, mobilize, and execute mid to large scale technical projects and programs, ensuring system solutions are architecturally sound, rigorously tested, and that organizations are ready for process and technology changes. The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation running through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.
Apple’s Services—including the App Store, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV, and many others—are among the most dynamic and widely used in the world. As the regulatory landscape continues to evolve, our organization requires proactive, technically rigorous leadership to ensure our platforms navigate emerging obligations while preserving product integrity and user trust.
We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager based in the US to lead a team responsible for driving strategic China regulatory and compliance work within Apple’s Services organization. In this role, you will lead the application of regulatory and compliance obligations into products, systems architecture, and data flows, manage key operating partner relationships, and bridge communication across US engineering, local Apple teams in China, and executive leadership.
Apple operates services in China at a scope and scale unlike any other multinational company. The challenges we face have no playbook. Our work is exceptionally complex, ambiguous, and vital to Apple’s operations. This role is focused on how expanding data and internet regulations in China impact Apple’s services, specifically driving the practical application of regulations into systems architecture, data governance, and data export rules.
In response to these regulatory and compliance obligations, Apple maintains strategic and operating partnerships for several of our services in China. This role serves as a key owner of those relationships, collaborating closely from the US with both local Apple teams and external operating partners to ensure our services operate reliably and securely, while maintaining compliance with evolving rules.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
8+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in cloud or internet services.
4+ years of formal people management experience, successfully leading and developing senior technical teams.
4+ years of dedicated experience translating legal, regulatory, compliance, or data governance requirements into technical specifications and engineering roadmaps.
Demonstrated technical competence evaluating services architectures, backend data flows, or cloud infrastructure.
Proven track record managing and negotiating complex technical, operational, or business relationships with external strategic partners.
Demonstrated excellence communicating with and influencing senior leadership across engineering, legal, business, product, and operations organizations to drive high-stakes decisions.
Preferred qualifications:
In-depth experience leading technical compliance or engineering initiatives. Experience with China internet or data regulations a strong plus.
Experience collaborating extensively across time zones with engineering, operations, and partner teams in China; professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is a strong plus.
Direct experience participating in or preparing engineering organizations for technical audits, regulatory inquiries, or external certification reviews.
Deep domain experience with consumer internet platforms or cloud infrastructure operating at a global scale.
Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical technical leadership experience.

Our Ad Platforms team applies that belief by delivering ads that add value, helping people discover content, supporting creators, and protecting and respecting everyone’s privacy. Our technology powers ads in the App Store, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV. We help developers and marketers of all sizes drive discovery of their apps across the App Store. Our display ads in Apple News and Stocks aid advertisers in promoting their products alongside trusted content in a brand-safe environment, while supporting publishers and journalists. We help advertisers connect with captivated audiences with our sponsorship integrations and experiences in live sports on Apple TV. Everything we do is with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone.

jobs.title: MBA Internships
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. The people here at Apple don’t just build products — they craft the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that supports the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.
MBA internships are available in the following areas and roles:

=== AI/ML EPM ===

The people working at Apple in machine learning and AI are building amazing experiences into every product, allowing millions to do what they never imagined. Because Apple fully integrates hardware and software across every device, our research and engineering teams are able to collaborate more effectively to improve the user experience, while protecting user data. We ship world-class consumer products leveraging the power of AI to enable new ways of interacting with technology and the physical world; empowering our customers to learn, communicate, and accomplish more while focusing on what matters most to them.

=== APPLECARE ===

Contact Center Operations: Optimizes the latest technologies and strategies to support the business and operational needs with tactical support to provide Apple customers. Monitor service level and contact center volumes as well as direct strategic Apple care business goals.

Field Service Channel Manager: Ensures high customer satisfaction and lowers operational cost by reengineering processes and policies. Influence Apple Authorized Service Providers and mobile carriers to craft premium service programs that support business objectives and Apple’s customers worldwide.

Global Repair Center: Own the operations of the growing network of Apple repair centers around the world in the rapidly growing AppleCare reverse supply chain to handle complex repairs.

Online/Digital Support & Service: Crafts compelling digital content solutions to improve the Apple customer experience, support the Advisor population to develop solutions to answer customer questions, inspire learning, and connect customers to the repair with assisted support. Brings innovative self-solve learning solutions to customers on the web, through an application on a device, on social platforms, search optimization, and machine learning.

Procurement: Manages AppleCare’s OEM supplier’s relationship, sourcing optimization, early engagement for repair strategy development, post-production planning including costs, continuity of supply, and capacity planning activities.

Reporting & Analytics: Harnesses the vast amount of data relating to AppleCare’s business to make strategic recommendations and share insights about ongoing operations. Translating business needs into analytical requirements using advanced quantitative analysis.

Supply Chain Management: Build and run AppleCare’s Global Reverse Supply Chains, through optimization of forecasting. Analyze and calculate new buy planning, repair planning, inventory management, purchasing, warranty redemption, and project management.

=== APPLE SERVICES ===

Apple has a full-range of services, including Apple Music, Apple News, Apple Podcasts, the Apple TV app, and Apple TV+, as well as Apple Pay, Apple Card, Maps, Search Ads, Apple’s iCloud services, and Apple’s productivity and creativity apps. Apple Services empower our customers to get the most out of the devices they love with high‑quality content and services. Award‑winning series and films, amazing music in spatial audio, world-class workouts and meditations, trusted news publications, super fun games — even the ways you pay for things.
Our Services team has an excellent track record of building and strengthening extraordinary services that meet and exceed the high expectations of Apple’s customers, and offer creators and storytellers the opportunity to bring their creative visions to people around the world. These opportunities span across software engineering, data science/analytics, QA, marketing, business development, and more.

=== MANUFACTURING DESIGN ===

Manufacturing Design - Global Supply Manager:

Responsible for the commercial relationship with our enclosure manufacturing partners for cost negotiations, risk management, driving operational and cost efficiencies through process or design change, as well overall project execution. You sit at the intersection of business activities and engineering communities, and efficiently and effectively balance the needs of both groups to ensure successful product launches.

Enclosure components (such as the housing, cover glass, and buttons) define the look, feel, and expression of our globally-recognized industrial and product design. GSMs work in concert with operations supply quality and base engineers as well as Apple’s Product Design and Industrial Design teams. Together, these teams execute and scale both new and existing manufacturing processes, materials, technologies, finishes, and form factors.

=== MARKETING ===

As a member of our Product Marketing group, you’ll shepherd a product’s positioning from concept through development and launch, to give it the best chance of success in the market. You’ll apply customer insights to help infuse ideas for groundbreaking features into our product-development process. Together with our team, you’ll work to craft groundbreaking ideas into tangible products that excite the world!

At Apple, we combine product management and product marketing responsibilities into a single, cross functional Product Management role. We collaborate with design, engineering, finance, legal, marketing communications, public relations, market research, sales and support for maximum impact across the organization.

=== PRODUCT OPERATIONS ===

Operations Program Manager:

As an OPM, you will work with our New Product Introduction ("NPI") or Sustaining Operations teams on component & ramp readiness, product launch & ramp through ‘end of life’ programs. Run the product manufacturability, testability, and responsiveness in pursuit of low cost and maximum flexibility while stewarding the highest standards of product quality expected of Apple's products.

A successful OPM excels in program/project management; communicates with ease at all levels; is adept at facilitating actions and resolving conflicts; manages through relationships and influence; and brings calm and control to even the highest-intensity projects.

Product Quality Manager (PQM)

PQMs lead the final quality of the completed product and are leaders within the operations technical team during product development and production. You are responsible for driving Apple’s highest of quality standards while ensuring the team delivers on operational metrics for UPH and yield. PQMs are the critical link between engineering and operations and a successful PQM will be able to address technical issues while understanding and effectively communicating the larger business impact.

You will ensure operational technical readiness for all phases of the introduction cycle, including driving contract manufacturer preparation, validations, and product transfers. Finally, as a key driver of leading-edge operational innovations you lead development and implementation of new technologies to enhance production quality, capacity, and efficiency.

=== RETAIL ===

The Apple Retail corporate team crafts the strategies, drives the initiatives, and builds the technologies that bring Apple products to more than 4.5 million visitors every day across our global e-commerce footprint and 450+ store locations worldwide. MBA interns take on roles equivalent to a program manager, product manager, business analyst, merchandising manager, or operations manager across areas including Central Operations, E-Commerce, Merchandising, Real Estate, and Sales & Service.

=== STRATEGIC SOURCING ===

Global Supply Manager:

You will interface between Apple and the industries that supply core component technologies. In this role, you are responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies as well as recommending product innovations based on improving technology. This position requires an interest in market dynamics and competitive behavior, negotiation and pricing, manufacturing processes, and risk mitigation.

Operations Product Development (OPD)

The OPD team serves as the “one-stop shop” to advise the development teams on operational, cost, and supply chain issues. Operations Product Managers understand key technologies from a cost, supply chain, and technical perspective, manage product cost based on targets, partner closely with GSMs to meet these targets, and develop the Supplier Plan of Record for each new product.

Materials Program Manager (MPM)

MPMs influence and run supply chain activities by working directly with these partners to optimize supply constraints in light of demand priorities, factory capacity, logistics requirements, quality challenges, and materials flow throughout Apple’s multi-tier supply chain. MPMs lead supply availability throughout the entire product life cycle ensuring supply optimization and minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.

=== SUPPLY CHAIN OPERATIONS ===

Supply Demand Management (role: Supply Demand Planner):

In SDM, you will hold a critical role in Apple's multi-billion dollar supply chain decisions by forecasting product demand, analyzing production needs, allocating global supply across all channels of distribution and influencing quarterly sales projections used in guidance to Wall Street. Your job will require you to collaborate and influence across many key groups within Apple all in an effort to both set the strategy and drive the execution of products across Apple’s global supply chain.

Business Process Re-engineering (role: BPR Project Manager):

In BPR, you will lead sophisticated, global initiatives to define, build, and roll out innovative technology and business process solutions that increase efficiencies, improve customer satisfaction, and challenge the status quo. You will define and build capabilities that provide deep business insight, enable rapid decision-making, and drive automation of evolving business processes.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Currently pursuing a MBA or master’s degree in supply chain, engineering, operations management, or a related field
At the end of the internship, you must return to school to continue your education or the internship must be the last requirement for you to graduate.
Preferred qualifications:
It’s helpful if you meet one or more of the following qualifications, but it isn’t a requirement
Ability to engage in strategic and detail-orientated thinking
Problem solving & issue resolution skills
Ability to influence cross-functional team members
Ability to adapt to dynamic and rapidly changing environments
Excellent analytical skills
Excellent communication skills
Ability to dive deep into complex detail and emerge with clear strategies and plans
